Other A locations: right is a red square (color and shape probabilities near 1.0) but not selected;
lower is almost certainly a blue cross;
Predicted next selections in A if given a redirect command: "upper"/"right"/"lower"/"left" all largely keep selection on upper (probabilities ≈0.997–0.999), so commands have little effect on A.

View B: attention is currently assigned to the right location (selection probability 0.99873). That object is very likely a yellow cross; its recoverability is ~0.652 now, ~0.492 after one step, ~0.374 after two.
Other B locations: upper likely a red triangle,
Redirect commands strongly change B: "right" keeps right selected (~0.9995); "upper" selects upper (~0.9997); "lower" selects lower (~0.9994); "left" selects left (~0.99996).
